mapper.sql: rcmd_id::text AS "rcmdId",rank_ord::int AS rank,rcmd_type_cd AS type,opp_id AS "opportunityId",need_sn::text AS "needSn",proj_id AS "projectId",job_cd AS "jobCode",bgn_ym AS "startMonth",dev_id AS "developerId",score_dtl AS "scoreDetail",user_act_cd AS "actionCode",rcmd_excl_cd AS "exclusionReasonCode",act_user_id AS "actedBy",act_dttm AS "actedAt",reg_dttm AS "registeredAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_sl_rcmd_log WHERE rcmd_id=CAST(#{rcmdId} AS numeric) AND rank_ord=#{rank}
SELECT FROM tb_sl_rcmd_log WHERE rcmd_id=CAST(#{rcmdId} AS numeric) AND rank_ord=#{rank} FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT ON(chg_item_nm) chg_item_nm AS item,aft_val AS value FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SL_RCMD_LOG' AND trgt_key=(#{rcmdId}||':'||CAST(#{rank} AS text)) ORDER BY chg_item_nm,hist_id

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'source',(), 'skills',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.dev_id,s.skill_nm) FROM tb_hr_dev_skill s), 'opportunities',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o) ORDER BY o.opp_id) FROM tb_sl_opp o), 'needs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n) ORDER BY n.opp_id,n.need_sn) FROM tb_sl_opp_need n), 'tentatives',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.tent_id) FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn t), 'recommendations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.rcmd_id,r.rank_ord) FROM tb_sl_rcmd_log r WHERE r.user_act_cd='EXCL'), 'lifecycle',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(h) ORDER BY h.hist_id) FROM tb_sy_chg_hist h WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm IN ('TB_SL_OPP','TB_PJ_PROJ')) )::text
SELECT asgn_id FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} ORDER BY asgn_id
SELECT pay_ym FROM tb_hr_mon_pay WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} UNION SELECT input_ym FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT opp_id FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} AND tent_stat_cd='ACT' ORDER BY opp_id
SELECT opp_id FROM tb_sl_opp WHERE opp_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT proj_id FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE proj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT dev_id FROM tb_hr_dev WHERE dev_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT asgn_id FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY asgn_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT need_sn::text FROM tb_sl_opp_need WHERE opp_id=#{id} ORDER BY need_sn FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE tb_cl_close IN SHARE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT n.opp_id AS "opportunityId",n.need_sn::text AS "needSn",n.job_cd AS "jobCode",n.bgn_ym AS "startMonth",n.prd_mcnt::int AS months,n.need_cnt::int AS count,o.opp_stat_cd AS status,o.ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",o.opp_nm AS name FROM tb_sl_opp_need n JOIN tb_sl_opp o ON o.opp_id=n.opp_id WHERE n.opp_id=#{opportunityId} AND n.need_sn=CAST(#{needSn} AS numeric)
SELECT dev_id AS id,job_cd AS "jobCode",emp_type_cd AS "employeeType",drct_cls_cd AS "directClass",use_yn AS "useYn",jncmp_dt AS "joinDate",retire_dt AS "retireDate" FROM tb_hr_dev WHERE dev_id=#{id}

SELECT a.asgn_id AS id,a.input_end_dt AS "endDate",a.ext_psbl_cd AS "extensionPossibility",a.asgn_stat_cd AS status,p.proj_stat_cd AS "projectStatus" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} AND asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND input_bgn_dt>#{date})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} AND tent_stat_cd='CNVT')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_hr_dev_stat WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} AND work_stat_cd='LEAVE' AND bgn_dt<=#{endDate} AND (end_dt IS NULL OR end_dt>=#{startDate}))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id='RCMD_EXCL' AND c.code=#{code} AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sl_opp WHERE opp_id=#{opportunityId} AND opp_stat_cd='ING'SELECT 1 FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE proj_id=#{projectId} AND proj_stat_cd='ING')

SELECT max(a.input_end_dt) FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id WHERE a.dev_id=#{developerId} AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND p.proj_stat_cd='ING' AND a.input_bgn_dt<=#{today} AND a.input_end_dt>=#{today}

SELECT max(reg_dttm) FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SL_OPP' AND trgt_key=#{opportunityId}'TB_PJ_PROJ' AND trgt_key=#{projectId} AND (chg_type_cd='RESUME' OR (chg_item_nm IN ('OPP_STAT_CD','PROJ_STAT_CD') AND bfr_val='STOP' AND aft_val='ING'))
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sl_rcmd_log SET user_act_cd=#{action},rcmd_excl_cd=#{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR},act_user_id=#{actor},act_dttm=#{now} WHERE rcmd_id=CAST(#{key.rcmdId} AS numeric) AND rank_ord=#{key.rank} AND user_act_cd IS NULL
